params.context: Optional bytes32 tag (session id / product id / referral)        emitted for off-chain analytics. Zero is fine.

BASE_GAS.details: Fixed per-tx overhead (tx base cost ~21,000 gas) added to the      measured gasleft() delta, so recorded gas is close to real usage.

heavyRecords.details: Permanent on-chain records written by heavy calls (real data).

rebatePerGas.details: RON (wei) rebated per unit of gas recorded (e.g. 1 gwei per 1M gas).

totalOwed.details: Total RON (wei) currently owed to users (cannot be drained by      emergencyWithdraw; only recoverUnclaimed / recoverAllUnclaimed      move it, and only back to the owner).

userList.details: Grow-only list of user addresses (enables recoverAllUnclaimed      and cheap on-chain leaderboards).

emergencyWithdraw(address).notice: Owner can withdraw only the surplus above all user obligations.

logActivity(bytes32).notice: The main interaction. Every call is a real transaction that         spends gas; the contract records how much the caller spent.

logActivityHeavy(bytes32,uint256).notice: High-gas interaction: writes `slots` real session records to         permanent storage. Caller pays the real gas for that work.

recoverAllUnclaimed().notice: Owner recovers ALL users' unclaimed rebates in one tx.

recoverUnclaimed(address).notice: Owner recovers ONE user's unclaimed rebates at any time.

register().notice: One-time registration. Establishes the user's gas ledger.

setMaxHeavySlots(uint256).notice: Owner-adjustable cap on slots per heavy call (gas safety).

setRebatePerGas(uint256).notice: Set the rebate rate (wei per gas unit). 0 disables rebates.

setTreasury(address).notice: Change the treasury (info only; PoD portal uses its own registry).

userdoc.notice: A gas-fee ledger + rebate vault for the Ronin network. Why this contract exists ------------------------ Ronin's "Proof of Distribution" (PoD) rewards builders for the on-chain activity generated by the contracts they register. One of the six scored dimensions is **Gas Spend** — the RON fees users pay to the Ronin treasury by transacting with your registered contracts. GasSpend makes gas spend the *product*:   1. Users interact with this contract (register, logActivity, claim).      Every interaction is a real transaction that pays gas in RON.   2. The contract measures and permanently records the gas each user      spent (via gasleft() deltas + a fixed per-tx base).   3. The owner funds a RON rebate pool; users earn a rebate proportional      to the gas they spent, so they are incentivised to keep using it —      which keeps generating the gas-fee volume PoD scores. Recovery mechanism ------------------ The owner can recover UNCLAIMED rebates at ANY time:   - recoverUnclaimed(user)   -> claw back one user's unclaimed rebate   - recoverAllUnclaimed()    -> claw back every user's unclaimed rebate This is an owner-controlled design (users are expected to claim regularly). Already-claimed RON can never be taken back, and the emergencyWithdraw() surplus rule is unchanged. Security notes: checks-effects-interactions, reentrancy guard on all value-moving functions, rebate obligations tracked so the owner's emergencyWithdraw can never touch user balances except via recovery.
